heading.en: From a rate law to a clock

hook.en: A doctor needs to know how much of a drug is left in the blood after six hours. Integrated rate equations turn a rate law into concentration as a function of time.
hook.kn: ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ನಂತರ ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಔಷಧ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಕಲಿತ ದರ ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳು ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾಲದ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Use the integrated equations for zero- and first-order reactions
Identify order from a linear plot

narration.en: A doctor needs to know how much of a drug is left in the blood after six hours. Integrated rate equations turn a rate law into concentration as a function of time.
narration.kn: ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ನಂತರ ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಔಷಧ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಸಮಾಕಲಿತ ದರ ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳು ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಾಲದ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: For a zero-order reaction the rate does not depend on concentration: −d[R]/dt = k. Integrating gives [R] = [R]₀ − kt, so [R] falls linearly with time. Examples: decomposition of NH₃ on a hot platinum surface at high pressure, and of HI on gold. The surface is fully covered, so adding more gas does not speed it up.
body.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದರ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ: [R] = [R]₀ − kt. ಉದಾ: ಬಿಸಿ ಪ್ಲಾಟಿನಂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೋನಿಯಾದ ವಿಭಜನೆ.

narration.en: For a zero-order reaction the rate does not depend on concentration: −d[R]/dt = k. Integrating gives [R] = [R]₀ − kt, so [R] falls linearly with time. Examples: decomposition of NH₃ on a hot platinum surface at high pressure, and of HI on gold. The surface is fully covered, so adding more gas does not speed it up.
narration.kn: ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದರ ಸಾರತೆಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ: [R] = [R]₀ − kt. ಉದಾ: ಬಿಸಿ ಪ್ಲಾಟಿನಂ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮೋನಿಯಾದ ವಿಭಜನೆ.

title.en: On the board: integrated rate equations

say.en: For a zero-order reaction the concentration falls in a straight line with slope minus k.
For a first-order reaction, integrating gives ln R equals ln R zero minus k t.
So ln R against t is a straight line; that straight line is the test for first order.
Example: a first-order reaction is 80 percent complete in 40 minutes. 20 percent is left, so k is 2.303 over 40 times log 5.
For a gas-phase reaction A gives B plus C, followed by total pressure, the pressure of A is 2 p initial minus p total.

body.en: For a first-order reaction −d[R]/dt = k[R]. Integrating gives ln[R] = ln[R]₀ − kt, or k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). A plot of log[R] against t is a straight line with slope −k/2.303. Examples: decomposition of N₂O₅, hydrogenation of ethene, and all natural radioactive decay. For a gas-phase reaction A(g) → B(g) + C(g) followed by total pressure p_t, p_A = 2p_i − p_t.
body.kn: ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). log[R] ಮತ್ತು t ನಡುವಿನ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಉದಾ: N₂O₅ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕ್ಷಯ.

narration.en: For a first-order reaction −d[R]/dt = k[R]. Integrating gives ln[R] = ln[R]₀ − kt, or k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). A plot of log[R] against t is a straight line with slope −k/2.303. Examples: decomposition of N₂O₅, hydrogenation of ethene, and all natural radioactive decay. For a gas-phase reaction A(g) → B(g) + C(g) followed by total pressure pt, pA = 2pi − pt.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). log[R] ಮತ್ತು t ನಡುವಿನ ನಕ್ಷೆ ಸರಳರೇಖೆ. ಉದಾ: N₂O₅ ವಿಭಜನೆ, ವಿಕಿರಣಶೀಲ ಕ್ಷಯ.

caption.en: For a first-order reaction, log[R] against t is a straight line. Its slope is −k/2.303 and its intercept is log[R]₀.

tryThis.en: Make the slope steeper: that is a larger rate constant.
Compare with [R] against t for a zero-order reaction: also a straight line, with slope −k.

narration.en: For a first-order reaction, log[R] against t is a straight line. Its slope is −k/2.303 and its intercept is log[R]₀. Make the slope steeper: that is a larger rate constant. Compare with [R] against t for a zero-order reaction: also a straight line, with slope −k.

caption.en: Zero-order and first-order decay from the same start. The zero-order line hits zero; the first-order curve only approaches it.

tryThis.en: Double [R]₀: the zero-order reaction takes twice as long to finish, but the first-order half-life does not change.
Make k larger: both fall faster.

narration.en: Zero-order and first-order decay from the same start. The zero-order line hits zero; the first-order curve only approaches it. Double [R]₀: the zero-order reaction takes twice as long to finish, but the first-order half-life does not change. Make k larger: both fall faster.

problem.en: In a first-order reaction the concentration falls from 0.8 mol L⁻¹ to 0.2 mol L⁻¹ in 30 minutes. Find k.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. In a first-order reaction the concentration falls from 0.8 mol L⁻¹ to 0.2 mol L⁻¹ in 30 minutes. Find k.

problem.en: A zero-order reaction has [R]₀ = 0.5 mol L⁻¹ and k = 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. When will [R] be 0.2 mol L⁻¹, and when is the reaction complete?

Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the pattern of NEET, JEE. Try them before we discuss.
CBSE board pattern. Read each assertion and reason carefully, and for case-based questions use the data in the passage before choosing an option.

points.en: Zero order: [R] = [R]₀ − kt; [R] vs t is linear.
First order: k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]); log[R] vs t is linear.
For A(g) → B(g) + C(g): p_A = 2p_i − p_t.

homework.en: A first-order reaction has k = 0.0462 min⁻¹. How long will it take for the concentration to fall to one-eighth?

narration.en: Recap. Zero order: [R] = [R]₀ − kt; [R] vs t is linear. First order: k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]); log[R] vs t is linear. For A(g) → B(g) + C(g): p_A = 2p_i − p_t.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಶೂನ್ಯ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕ: [R] = [R]₀ − kt. ಪ್ರಥಮ ಕ್ರಮಾಂಕ: k = (2.303/t) log([R]₀/[R]). ಅನಿಲ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ p_A = 2p_i − p_t.
